title: War Frank
creator: CrossFit
description: Three rounds of 25 muscle-ups, 100 squats and 35 GHD sit-ups, for time. Honours U.S. Marine Capt. Warren A. Frank, killed supporting combat operations in Ninewa Province, Iraq, in 2008. Seventy-five muscle-ups: one of the highest-skill Hero WODs, so scale to pull-ups and dips.
